notes: Read by code from the Parcoursup fiche (French level, distance learning) and from Campus France national pages (duration, fees for a non-EU student at a public institution, certificate, platform). The national facts are not this programme's own page. | Tuition: the only figure stated for this programme is 178 euros per year (Parcoursup page), which corresponds to the rate for French/EU students. The page does not state the differentiated tuition fee for non-EU students; the 2 902 euros figure on the Campus France Morocco page is a general national figure, not specific to this programme. Language: the programme is taught in French; B2 level in French is required to enrol, and a French certification (TCF/DELF B2/DALF) is compulsory for the Campus France procedure unless exempt. Application channel not extracted per instructions: a Moroccan applicant with a Moroccan Bac applies via Études en France / Campus France, not Parcoursup.
